# GOTOMA Group

> GOTOMA Group is a Polish technology group headquartered in Nowy Sącz that delivers IT projects for businesses in an "IT 360" model: software, e-commerce, infrastructure and hardware, security and AI solutions. The Group consists of GOTOMA GENERAL, GOTOMA Software House, Codarius and ERP Factory. A company with an issue that spans several areas contacts one place, and the Group defines the scope and identifies the company that will lead the project.

Key facts:
- Headquarters: Nowy Sącz, Poland
- Group: more than 14 years on the market, more than 300 completed projects, more than 70 experts
- Group companies: GOTOMA GENERAL (digitalisation coordination and IT general contracting), GOTOMA Software House (custom software and AI solutions), Codarius (e-commerce platform and online marketing), ERP Factory (company developing its own ERP system)
- GOTOMA GENERAL is an authorised enova365 partner; GOTOMA Software House is a member of the Evoluma technology cluster
- The Group complements its offering with solutions from external partners, including investment financing, CRM, WMS and TMS, PIM, hardware and hosting, and online marketing
- AI implementation principle: the system prepares and suggests, while decisions involving responsibility (accounting, tax, legal, commercial) remain with people
- This file covers the English version of the website. The Polish version is described in https://www.grupagotoma.pl/llms.txt

## Group companies
- [GOTOMA GENERAL](https://gotomageneral.com/en/): digitalisation coordination and turnkey IT general contracting: hardware, infrastructure, software, cybersecurity, Private AI environments, tenders and investment financing
- [GOTOMA Software House](https://gotoma.pl/en/): custom systems and applications: CRM, ERP, MES, WMS, TMS, web and mobile applications, integrations, AI solutions, staff augmentation and managed teams
- [Codarius](https://codarius.com/): e-commerce platform for launching an online store, plus marketing services: visual identity, SEO, content marketing, social media, Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns
- [ERP Factory](https://erpfactory.tech/): Group company developing its own ERP platform for company management: projects and investments, human resources, budgets and cash flow, with AI mechanisms that suggest decisions to managers

## Business solutions
- [360° Consultation](https://www.grupagotoma.pl/en/business-solutions/360-consultation/): entry point for projects that span several areas or do not yet have a defined solution; the Group defines the scope, the sequence of steps and the lead company
- [AI and automation](https://www.grupagotoma.pl/en/business-solutions/ai-and-automation/): AI in sales, customer service, document workflows and operations; projects run from process analysis through a pilot to implementation
- [Private AI and cybersecurity](https://www.grupagotoma.pl/en/business-solutions/private-ai-and-cybersecurity/): AI for data that cannot leave the company; environments for confidential data, infrastructure security (NIS2, DORA) and AI Act compliance
- [Sales digitalisation](https://www.grupagotoma.pl/en/business-solutions/sales-digitalisation/): the sales process and its CRM support, generating enquiries and handing orders over to fulfilment, the warehouse and accounting
- [Digital transformation](https://www.grupagotoma.pl/en/business-solutions/digital-transformation/): the company's core system (ERP), a single source of product data (PIM), integrations and custom software
- [E-commerce and B2B platforms](https://www.grupagotoma.pl/en/business-solutions/e-commerce-and-b2b-platforms/): online stores for end customers and ordering platforms for regular business partners with their individual terms
- [IT for manufacturing and logistics](https://www.grupagotoma.pl/en/business-solutions/it-for-manufacturing-and-logistics/): production workflow (MES), warehouse and transport (WMS), machinery maintenance; implementation starts with one part of the plant
